primary_source.identity: 高超声速气动布局理论及应用, 第11章 双模态冲压发动机一维数值模拟

rationale: The teacher model advances the three quasi-one-dimensional flow equations and closes local mixture composition algebraically from equivalence ratio and combustion efficiency.
Eq.11.23 defines phi from prescribed fuel and incoming-air mass flow rates.
Eq.11.19 defines mixing efficiency from axial distance to an injection point and Eq.11.20 defines the associated complete-mixing length.
The transcribed source does not introduce a species-transport PDE system or a time-evolution equation for phi, eta, or Y_i.
source_alignment_decision.correction_to_prior_planning_language: Earlier planning language described the next step as a dynamic phi/eta/Y_i update. P11.3H replaces that implementation plan with a source-aligned spatial closure held fixed during pseudo-time unless later teacher evidence explicitly requires time-dependent composition evolution.

implemented_chain: Eq.11.23 scalar downstream equivalence ratio from injected fuel and incoming-air mass flow
Eq.11.20 local mixing length from phi and local combustor height
Eq.11.19 raw mixing efficiency versus distance from one injection station
explicit project adapter eta=min(eta_m_raw,1) without modifying the raw correlation
Eq.11.27 H2 or Eq.11.29 C2H4 lean composition field
direct compatibility with the accepted prescribed-composition SSP-RK3 solver
scientific_boundaries: Current closure is for one prescribed injection station; distributed d(mdot_f)/dx is not silently converted into a cumulative fuel-flow profile.
Current source-backed thermochemical composition branch requires phi <= 1.
H2 and C2H4 are thermochemistry-ready; C10H22 remains blocked by missing source-backed thermo polynomials.
No species-transport PDE or finite-rate chemistry is introduced.
No independent chemical Qdot is added for teacher reaction energy.
Fuel mass/momentum/enthalpy source coupling and wall-source coupling remain separate next steps.
next_step: Couple a source-backed single-injector fuel mass/momentum/enthalpy source to the P11.3H composition field and teacher friction adapter, while keeping wall-heat conversion gated until its dimensional relation is frozen.
